edits.value_json: {"text":"Pip rested on the ribbon by the gate, and its wings painted one small shadow across the paper moon. Ada’s grand show had become a tiny silver hello. Bo’s bell stayed silent, but nobody seemed to mind. The children stood very still while the moth’s silver dust trembled like a little star in the lamplight.","when":[{"key":"pip.location","op":"eq","value":"ribbon","at":"after"},{"key":"pip.content","op":"eq","value":"welcomed","at":"after"},{"key":"ada.performed.mode","op":"eq","value":"tableau","at":"after"}]}

{"text":"Among the moonflowers, Pip tasted the night with its delicate feet. Bo knelt nearby, and Ada watched without waving her hands. The blossoms nodded in the soft garden, keeping Pip’s curious little visit company. Somewhere above them, a leaf let go of one round drop of dew, and Pip’s wings gave a pleased little shiver.","when":[{"key":"pip.location","op":"eq","value":"moonflowers","at":"after"},{"key":"pip.content","op":"eq","value":"curious","at":"after"}]}

{"text":"Pip slipped behind the gate, startled by the bright dancing shapes. Still, the quiet gate opening remained moonlit, and one feeler peeked around the edge. Ada lowered the lamp. The welcome was unfinished, but not gone. Bo left the garden hushed, while a tiny wingbeat stirred the darkness like a question waiting for tomorrow.","when":[{"key":"pip.location","op":"eq","value":"gate","at":"after"},{"key":"pip.content","op":"eq","value":"startled","at":"after"},{"key":"ada.performed.mode","op":"eq","value":"shadows","at":"after"}]}

{"text":"On the gate, the paper moon glowed softly while Pip made a tiny shadow of its own. Ada’s huge shadow-dream had folded down to moth-size, just right for the night. Bo’s hands rested beside the silent bell, and the children watched the little shadow flutter without asking it to become anything bigger.","when":[{"key":"pip.location","op":"eq","value":"ribbon","at":"after"},{"key":"ada.performed.mode","op":"eq","value":"tableau","at":"after"}]}
